scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const b = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const f = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { b.kill(); f.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npx @vercel/ncc build backend/dist/server.js -o api -m
